entities.name: Asada Goryu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Asada Gōryū  was a Japanese physician and astronomer who helped integrate western and Japanese astronomy in the Edo period. He introduced several western astronomical instruments and methods into Japan and independently confirmed Kepler's third law.
